data.title: About Us
data.description: RS Software brings multi-rail expertise across the digital payments value chain — infrastructure, applications and services. Meet our leadership, values and culture.

hero.title: About Us
hero.html: RS Software brings multi-rail expertise developed by delivering transformative solutions across the digital payments value chain – Infrastructure, Application, Services – to address the value chain drivers: consumers and business.

what.title: What We Do
what.ledeHtml: We modernize the payments value chain with expertise across connectivity, core systems, value-added services, and acceptance.

cards.descHtml: Modernizing connectivity for direct and indirect participants with the new-age payment rails.
Modernizing payment systems and infrastructure with digital-first technology.
Solving use-cases that address the need for embedded, intelligent, real-time value transfer.
Enabling the last-mile value-delivery to customers through digitalization of the acceptance layer.

culture.title: Our Culture
culture.html: RS Software's exclusive focus on payments and proven track record of more than 28 years has made it the brand of choice for leading payments providers seeking to improve time to market for solutions that can generate additional revenues and save money. Our mission is to transform the lives of consumers, businesses, and nations with the power of digital payments.
culture.author: Raj Jain

philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.html: At RS Software we combine our core values with an emphasis on honesty, integrity, mutual respect and individual leadership. These form the guiding principles for our company and are the basis for long-lasting partnerships with some of the world's leading payment brands.

values.title: Values
values.ledeHtml: Global Leader in Providing Technology Solutions to the Electronic Payments Industry.

executives.name: Abhishek Gupta
executives.role: Global Head of Pre-sales & GTM Strategy (Digital Payment Products)

community.title: Community
community.html: At RS Software we take our responsibility to the community seriously. We believe in treating our employees, customers and shareholders with respect and compassion. We strive to extend those same courtesies to everyone we meet.
community.link: Read more about our community work
